mapper.insert: insert into agent_run ( run_id, agent_id, agent_code, agent_version_id, run_type, trigger_source, operator_id, operator_type, session_id, status, model_id_used, model_name_used, tool_call_count, tool_denied_count, repair_attempts, cost_ms, error_message, started_at, ended_at ) values ( #{runId}, #{agentId}, #{agentCode}, #{agentVersionId}, #{runType}, #{triggerSource}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorType}, #{sessionId}, #{status}, #{modelIdUsed}, #{modelNameUsed}, #{toolCallCount}, #{toolDeniedCount}, #{repairAttempts}, #{costMs}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt} )
mapper.update: update agent_run set status = #{status}, model_id_used = #{modelIdUsed}, model_name_used = #{modelNameUsed}, tool_call_count = coalesce(#{toolCallCount}, tool_call_count), tool_denied_count = coalesce(#{toolDeniedCount}, tool_denied_count), repair_attempts = coalesce(#{repairAttempts}, repair_attempts), cost_ms = #{costMs}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, ended_at = #{endedAt} where run_id = #{runId}
mapper.select: select run_id, agent_id, agent_code, agent_version_id, run_type, trigger_source, operator_id, operator_type, session_id, status, model_id_used, model_name_used, tool_call_count, tool_denied_count, repair_attempts, cost_ms, error_message, started_at, ended_at from agent_run where 1 = 1 and run_id = #{runId} limit 1
